description: This Java class defines an immutable data model 'GlimRepaymentTemplate' representing repayment details for a GLIM (Group Loan Individual Malaya) within the loan account system. It includes fields for IDs, client info, and principal amounts, with a factory method for instantiation and getter methods.

classes.name: GlimRepaymentTemplate
classes.description: Immutable data holder for GLIM repayment information with private constructor and static factory method.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new immutable instance of GlimRepaymentTemplate with specified values.

methods.name: getParentPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Returns the principal amount of the parent loan.

methods.name: getChildLoanAccountNo
methods.description: Returns the child loan account number.

methods.name: getChildPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Returns the principal amount of the child loan.
